Enter %1$s–%2$s µs at %3$d fps. Exposure must fit within a frame; the camera may need additional readout time.
Enter a whole number from ISO %1$d to %2$d.
%1$d fps requested · measured cadence appears in preview. Available rates depend on resolution; high-speed recording is excluded.
First shorten exposure to %1$s µs or less for this frame rate.
Frame rate changed to %1$d fps for the selected resolution.
100 µs, lowest ISO, 1280 × 960, 30 fps, and automatic focus/white balance locking where supported; otherwise the nearest supported settings.
Recommended settings restored for this camera.
Auto then Lock · focuses once when preview opens, then holds focus for preview and recording. Return from Settings to refocus.
Continuous Auto · focus can change during capture. Behavior with manual exposure depends on the camera.
Manual (Fixed) · holds the focus value entered below.
This camera has a fixed focus lens; no adjustment is needed.
This camera does not expose supported focus controls.
Automatic focus locking is unavailable on this camera.
Enter 0–%1$s diopters. 0 is infinity; 0.5 corresponds to approximately 2 m. Larger values focus closer.
Enter 0–%1$s in camera focus units. 0 is infinity; larger values focus closer. This camera does not report an accurately calibrated distance.
Choose Manual (Fixed) in Focus Mode to edit this value.
Auto then Lock · balances colors when preview opens, then holds them for preview and recording. Return from Settings to rebalance.
Auto (Unlocked) · colors can change during capture. Behavior with manual exposure depends on the camera.
This camera does not expose supported white balance controls.
Automatic white balance locking is unavailable on this camera.
Preparing focus and white balance…\nExposure adjusts temporarily before capture.
Applying manual exposure and confirming camera controls…
Focus could not lock. Aim at a clear subject, then open Settings and return to retry, or choose Manual focus.
Camera controls were not confirmed. Open Settings and return to retry, or choose manual focus and a fixed white balance preset.
Wait for focus and white balance to finish preparing before recording.
